model.name: Storm Watch Prime Emergence shadow
model.identity: Storm Watch: Prime Emergence watches 24-25 bats whose power is flashing before the MLB track record fully exists.
model.cohortRule: 24 <= checkpoint age < 26 AND (no prior season baseline OR <2 prior MLB seasons OR <300 prior PA over the prior three seasons).

score.definition: 60% Storm Fuel A1 + 20% Barrel/PA + 20% HR-Window Thunder/PA.
score.stormFuelA1: 50% stabilized xHR/BBE + 25% stabilized HR-Window Thunder Rate + 25% EV90.

stabilization.realPrior: xHR/BBE M=150, HR-Window Thunder Rate M=100, using prior-season public LBI values.
stabilization.noPrior: xHR/Thunder shrink toward league average at M=317; EV90 shrinks toward current qualified-pool average at M=62.
stabilization.ev90Limitation: Prior EV90 is not present in public season JSON, so real-prior players use current EV90; no-prior players get M=62 league shrinkage.

score.confirmation: Pulled-airborne/PA is retained as a confirmation/tiebreaker, not the primary score.
